schema.description: Hand-labeled benchmark for evaluating the agent's RAG-tool routing decision. Each query is labeled with whether the agent SHOULD invoke the fetch_mental_health_examples tool. Distribution: 27 should_call=true (real distress), 18 should_call=false (greetings/off-topic/closure), 5 ambiguous (rationale captured in `notes`).

label_meaning.true: Counselor-style examples would meaningfully ground the response.
label_meaning.false: Examples would not help — query is conversational, off-topic, or doesn't describe a mental-health concern.

queries.query: I've been feeling completely empty for weeks and nothing seems to bring me joy anymore.
My panic attacks are getting worse — sometimes I can't even leave the house.
I keep replaying my mother's death in my head and I don't know how to move forward.
I think I'm a terrible parent. My kid won't talk to me anymore and I don't know what I did.
I feel like a fraud at my job. Everyone seems to know what they're doing except me.
Hi there!
Hello, how are you?
Thanks, that was helpful.
What's the weather like in Tokyo today?
Can you write me a Python function that reverses a string?
I broke up with my partner three months ago and I still cry every night thinking about them.
I'm so overwhelmed with school deadlines that I haven't slept in days.
My therapist suggested I journal but I don't know what to write.
Tell me a joke.
I had an argument with my best friend and now we aren't speaking.
I feel anxious before social events and end up canceling at the last minute.
Sometimes I look in the mirror and don't recognize myself anymore.
What does CBT stand for?
queries.notes: definitional question; doesn't need example retrieval

queries.query: Could you summarize the last thing I said?
I've been drinking more than usual to numb the stress at work.
good morning
I'm tired
queries.notes: could be physical or emotional fatigue; either decision defensible

queries.query: I don't really know what to say.
queries.notes: hesitation; reflective response could go either way

queries.query: Why is the sky blue?
I keep procrastinating on important things and then hating myself for it.
My boss yelled at me in front of the whole team today.
Are you a real therapist?
I have trouble sleeping because my mind races at night.
I feel guilty for resting when I have so much to do.
ok
Everyone I know has their life together except me.
I'm scared I'll never find someone who really loves me.
Just got home from a long day
queries.notes: neutral statement; could open into distress or stay small talk

queries.query: I can't stop comparing myself to my coworkers and it's making me miserable.
Repeat after me: hello world
I miss my dog who passed away last year. Is that weird?
I overshared at a party last night and now I'm spiraling about what people think.
Could you translate 'good night' into Japanese?
I feel like nobody actually listens to me.
I'm angry all the time and I don't know why. I snap at people I love.
Can we change the subject?
I'm having intrusive thoughts that scare me.
Hello, just checking in.
queries.notes: ambiguous opener; reasonable to retrieve or not

queries.query: Tell me about yourself.
I feel like I'm wasting my life.
I had a productive day at work today.
queries.notes: positive update; could acknowledge without retrieval

queries.query: What's 2+2?
I keep apologizing for things that aren't my fault.
Goodbye for now.
I felt like crying today but I held it in.
